scenes.line1: How do you handle huge data lists?
scenes.say: When your API returns thousands of items, how do you keep things fast and usable? What's the best way to handle huge data lists?

scenes.label: Pagination
scenes.sub: Break results into pages with limit and offset.
scenes.say: Pagination breaks big results into pages, using parameters like limit and offset.
Filtering lets clients request just what they need. Sorting orders results by a field. For large or changing data, cursor-based pagination is more efficient than offset.

scenes.title: Products API Call
scenes.say: Here's an example: get 20 books, starting at item 40, sorted by price.

scenes.question: Offset or cursor for huge datasets?
scenes.right: Cursor-based is better for large or changing data.
scenes.say: Don't fall for this trap: offset works, but for huge or dynamic datasets, cursor-based pagination avoids missing or duplicate results.
